text:
jess: Quick sync — iterating copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private pages. Need hero + subhead variants and routing note for inbound leads. Can folks drop 1-line alternatives by EOD?

maria: thanks — high level: emphasize 'predictable performance' for Dedicated, 'fastest time-to-value' for Hosted, and 'data control' for Private. Keep hero short.

alex: agree. Also call out SLAs on Dedicated and VPC/KMS for Private. For Hosted, avoid promising specific p99 numbers.

sam: CTA test idea: 1) Try self-serve sign-up CTA 2) Request a capacity consult (for Dedicated) 3) Get deployment checklist (for Private). We'll route Dedicated leads to AE team, Private to solutions eng.

todd: layout constraint — hero must fit 72 chars max on mobile. Can we keep subhead to one sentence? I'll draft comps once copy is locked.

jess: cool. Proposed hero drafts:```
Hosted: 'Ship LLM features fast — hosted inference that just works.'
Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput. Dedicated GPU pools. SLA-backed.'
Private: 'Self‑managed inference inside your VPC — compliance & control.'
```

maria: thumbs up on tone. Tiny tweak: replace 'just works' with 'with production SLAs' on Hosted? feels too heavy. maybe 'with predictable performance'

alex: +1 for 'predictable performance' on Hosted. For Dedicated hero add 'autoscale & burst' mention? maybe in subhead.

sam: inbound routing: add hidden form field 'lead_tier' to landing pages: hosted, dedicated, private. Use /integrations/ae-bucket for Dedicated. I'll prep routing matrix.

todd: will mock mobile comps with the shorter heroes. Need final copy by 5pm PST.

deploy-bot: page-draft branch deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood.com/tri-deploy-hero-sync (build #384). Please review. :rocket:

jess: thanks everyone — I'll consolidate variants and post a follow-up with 3 finalists. Ping me if you want to champion a specific line.
